definitions.gloss: attic; space above the ceiling; ceiling cavity
definitions.explanation: The space between the ceiling and the roof of a building. Used for storage, running wires and ducts, or insulation. A compound of {天井|てんじょう} (ceiling) and {裏|うら} (behind; reverse side).

examples.japanese: {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収納|しゅうのう}→収納：07497_shuunou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To store things in the attic space.

examples.japanese: {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ネズミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear mice in the space above the ceiling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配線|はいせん}→配線：07862_haisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to go into the ceiling space for the wiring work.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧ (ceiling) and ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (behind; other side). In traditional Japanese houses, the {天井裏|てんじょううら} is often a relatively accessible space used for storage or insulation. It is also a common place where pests like mice or raccoon dogs (⟦{狸|たぬき}→狸：04341_tanuki⟧) may be heard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter the ceiling space
- {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧: ceiling insulation
- {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: inspection of the ceiling space
- {天井裏|てんじょううら}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hear sounds from above the ceiling

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{屋根裏|やねうら}→屋根裏：15854_yaneura⟧: attic — the space directly under the roof, often used interchangeably with {天井裏|てんじょううら}
- ⟦{床下|ゆかした}→床下：24969_yukashita⟧: under the floor — the space beneath the floor, another common area for inspection and maintenance
- ⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧: ceiling — the visible surface below the ceiling space
